crossRefs.note: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

translations.web: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
translations.bsb: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
translations.kjv: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
translations.asv: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
